title: A Storm on Jupiter Is Wider Than Earth, With 400 mph Winds

scenes.text: A storm on Jupiter is wider than the whole Earth.
It's the Great Red Spot, about ten thousand miles across.
Winds around its edge top four hundred miles an hour.
Earth's strongest hurricanes stay under about two hundred.
People have been watching this storm for at least a hundred and fifty years.
A storm bigger than our planet, and it's still going.

description:
A storm on Jupiter is wider than the whole Earth.
The Great Red Spot is about 10,000 miles across, with winds over 400 miles an hour.
Could you ever sail a spaceship through it?
first_comment: Would you rather fly through a Category 5 hurricane or the edge of the Great Red Spot?
